title: R package dependency declared without a version
description: DESCRIPTION declares a `Depends` entry with no version constraint. R installs the newest matching package from the configured repositories, so the analysis can change without a DESCRIPTION edit.
remediation: Record the version constraint, and pin the library with `renv.lock`.
limitation: It matches a `Depends` entry with no version constraint in the parsed DESCRIPTION; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
